comments: Information of tracklisting from Hal C F Astell's website.
Tommy apologises for not giving out the winners of the Jim Morrison video competition the previous week.

Date is confirmed by the news after the show, which reports on the Beirut car bombing that killed 60; the rescue of Lt. Cmdr. Clive Waghorn from a crevasse in Antarctica; and Peter Hogg being convicted of manslaughter for killing his wife.
